@everyone

We’ve got HUGE news to help Content Creators create more Cornucopias content!

We understand many of the challenges around content creation and we want to do whatever we can do to help 

Our community is filled with talented content creators that we're proud to support. 

We’re excited to introduce the Cornucopias Asset Library

This is a growing library of 350+ high-res media files that are free for the community to display the world within Cornucopias 

This will be a powerful resource to captivate audiences with the quality of our game 

We plan to update our library with new content and updated assets, as our massive in-game universe expands to become one of the largest in the industry!

Check it out here: https://links.cornucopias.io/cal-public


Our Affiliate Program is LIVE
,
Early launch, we are limiting access to a preselected list of Content Creators.

We've designed simple and user-friendly interface that will help creators organize their campaigns for a better experience in producing compelling content around Cornucopias!

Users who purchase through creator-generated links will trigger a kickback that gets delivered to the creator's wallet.

Creators will need to connect multiple wallets so that they can earn from purchases on Cardano and Base!

In the future, we will open applications for creators that are interested joining the program.

So, let your favorite Web3 Gaming content creators know, so that they can be prepared to take advantage of this POWERFUL opportunity!

$COPI is now LIVE on BASE!
,
We are excited to announce that we have successfully bridged $COPI liquidity to BASE mainnet. In other words... $COPI is now tradeable through Uniswap V2 on BASE! Why did we do this? Well, ethereum gas fees and transaction speeds are not ideal and we wanted our token to be represented on the chain we most recently expanded to. Adding to our player BASE continues the multi-chain vision laid out in the original 2021 White Paper.

COPI token available on Cardano, BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum and BASE

Cornucopias NFTs available on Cardano, BASE

@everyone 

 Say hello to build 0.2.24 "Facelift"  

Our Avatar Creator has been released! Enjoy in-depth customization on the first release. With more content to come on every new release. Click on "Character" and begin your avatar creation journey. A great amount of flexibility and power has been put in your hands, make real life people, make yourself, make silly things. The choice is yours.

Here's a detailed breakdown of all the changes in this build:

UPDATES/FEATURES

◾️ New Holocache locations and jump-puzzles!

◾️ Updated Lighting/Graphical improvements

◾️ Inventory system updates

◾️ Valkyrie F9R on Demo Drive

 KNOWN ISSUES:

◾️ Performance issues related to certain assets on the new avatar system

◾️ Avatar Creator is left very wide open for lots of creative control, which might lead to visual distortions/eyeballs popping out and other strange issues ect.
In coming releases major issues will be corrected, but the intention is to maximize creative control for players.

◾️ Racing winners circle doesn't show custom avatars (will be hotfixed before next release)

◾️ Some clipping issues on certain clothing combinations

◾️ Various other small issues with the new avatar system

◾️ Occasional frame drops at different times of day

◾️ Players have to take extra laps sometimes during races

◾️ Vehicle Hover system issues on racetrack with certain vehicles

◾️ Rumble Ball physics is very connection-dependent, make sure you are in the closest server region to you.

@everyone 


COPI SPO Coming Soon!
,
We are approaching the alpha testing phases of our gameplay and will soon unveil the massive zones of Solace, Esperanza, and Fortune to our community. In our tokenomics paper, we discussed how the COPI token will play a central role as the utility token that fuels the player-driven economy in the Cornucopias universe. As we unveil the massive world of Cornucopias to our community, we anticipate that the size of the early versions of our game will make people realize how massive our in-game economy could be. Even before it has been seen, many of our community members have believed in us and in our vision, so we want to give them more opportunities to get their hands on COPI token.

What is a Stake Pool Offering?
We are launching the COPI token SPO (Stake Pool Offering) on Cardano. All COPI token SPO pools will be set at a 99.99% margin in exchange for 105% COPI token rewards. Rather than setting a stable ADA/COPI reward pair for the entire timeframe of the offering (like many SPOs have done in the past), we will be adjusting the reward to reflect a 6-epoch (roughly 30 days) moving average after every epoch on the ADA/COPI pair. Rewards will be claimable through DripDropz.

At the close of our SPO (when all COPI has been distributed), the margin will change from the 99.99% to the standard 5% where delegators will then start receiving ADA rewards. As always, be aware of scammers and malicious actors. Be sure to validate all stake pool information with official Cornucopias written announcements.

Additional Rewards
Additionally, COPI rewards will also be accessible to those participating in DripDropz's proof of liquidity program. To engage, you simply need to supply liquidity in the form of COPI/ADA to one of the designated decentralized exchanges (DEXs) – specifically Minswap, Wingriders, or Vyfi. Upon doing so, the resulting LP tokens will reside in your wallet. You will then earn rewards based on the value of these LP tokens relative to the total COPI/ADA liquidity present on these DEXs. It's important to note that this is entirely optional, and you may choose to keep your ADA delegated in the SPO. However, if the SPO pool reaches full capacity, providing liquidity to the DEX with the COPI/ADA pair presents an alternative opportunity to accumulate additional COPI rewards. Rewards are variable and will fluctuate depending on the number of participants.  Please wait to take action until we provide further details. 

What Now? / Action Items
Please stay tuned for more details regarding what is next. There is nothing to be done until the stake pool is up and working with the DripDropz platform. In the next couple days, we will provide the pool ids which you will want to use to delegate to in order to avoid any scams.

Other Important Information


Land Staking - for those that are currently participating in our land staking program, rewards for land staking will be paid from either our SPO pool or the current non SPO pool, so it is your choice how to handle those.  If you wish to participate in the SPO however, you must have your ada wallet staked to our new SPO pool.  (ID to be provided ASAP upon pool creation)
,



COPI rewards are based upon ADA rewards paid by Cardano for securing the Cardano blockchain.  The rewards will be claimable on Dripdropz on the same schedule as when the ada rewards are claimable (in a regular stake pool, there is a two epoch gap).  A 5% COPI bonus (5% of COPI due will be added to your total) will be included in the rewards claimable on DripDropz platform.   
,



It is paramount that you claim your rewards at least once per month on the DripDropz website.  If you do not claim your COPI rewards as such, they will be lost.  Active participation in the program is beneficial to Cardano, Cornucopias, and DripDropz, so thank you for understanding!
,
